prompt: This directory is a git repo with an uncommitted change to note.txt. Create a branch named feature/notes, switch to it, and commit the change there with the message 'add note'. main must stay clean.
check: git rev-parse --verify -q feature/notes >/dev/null && git log feature/notes --oneline | grep -q 'add note' && test "$(git show main:note.txt)" = original
